mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4; mebendazole is metabolized by CYP3A4), potentially increasing mebendazole exposure and toxicity.
action: Monitor for mebendazole adverse effects (hepatotoxicity, gastrointestinal symptoms, bone marrow suppression); consider alternative antifungal if prolonged mebendazole therapy is required.
